test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT the purpose of lubrication oil in an engine?

options.text: Mixing of impurities uniformly that include aromatics and polar compounds
Finishing to improve oxidation and heat stability
Separation of lighter boiling materials such as gasoline, jet fuel, diesel, etc.

solution:
The correct answer is __Mixing of impurities uniformly that include aromatics and polar compounds.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lubrication oil__ serves multiple purposes in an engine to ensure smooth operation and longevity.
 
• It provides lubrication to reduce friction between moving parts.
 
• The oil acts as a coolant, dissipating heat generated during engine operation.
 
• It helps in cleaning the engine by carrying away contaminants and deposits.
 
• Lubrication oil also improves oxidation and heat stability through refining processes.
 
• It undergoes dewaxing to enhance low-temperature fluidity, ensuring performance in colder climates.
 
• However, __mixing of impurities uniformly__ is not a purpose of lubrication oil in an engine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Refining Processes:**

 
 
• Refining processes like dewaxing and finishing improve oil performance.
 
• These processes enhance the oil's thermal stability and resistance to oxidation.
 
 
 
• **Contaminant Removal:**
 
 
• Lubrication oil carries away impurities and prevents sludge formation.
 
• Periodic oil changes are essential to maintain engine cleanliness and performance.
 
 
 
• **Low-Temperature Performance:**
 
 
• Dewaxing processes improve the oil's fluidity in cold environments.
 
• This ensures that the oil can flow easily and provide lubrication even in low temperatures.
